title: gauge_bar component body
description: The body of a gauge_bar component (04 section 17 item 5): one channel, the scale, orientation and origin, the bar colour, the scale labels and the colour bands.

channelName.description: A channel as the workbook names it (D-013: resolved through mappings, aliases, case folding and the logged name); "" where the member is optional means none.

colour.description: A colour "#rrggbb" (alpha ff) or "#rrggbbaa"; written in lower case (Rgba, 04 section 5.1).

colourBands.description: ColourBands (04 section 7.3): ALT+n toggles band n; open extends a band below min or above max.

scaleSpec.description: A scale (04 sections 8.3, 10.2, 11.2, 17): channel = the channel override or the autoscale, auto = from the data shown, manual = min and max as written.

unitSymbolOrEmpty.description: A unit symbol or alias of the unit registry (units-1), or "" for the unitless unit; no leading or trailing white space.

unitValue.description: A persisted number with its unit (D-010): {"v": number, "unit": symbol}, "" for a unitless value. The value is in the unit as written; readers convert, writers keep the written unit.
